nodes.label: Meshify Phase I: AI Backend-as-a-Service
nodes.rationale: API-only platform giving each project an isolated, RAG-queryable knowledge base; Phase II (Next.js) will consume these APIs.

nodes.label: Pipeline-per-project, started once
nodes.rationale: Pipelines start lazily on first use with useExisting:true and are reused across requests because RocketRide documents pipeline-per-request as an anti-pattern.

nodes.label: Physical tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: Two Qdrant collections per project, never a shared collection with filters; project deletion removes collections before the Postgres row.

nodes.label: Search path (bypasses RocketRide)
nodes.rationale: RocketRide's qdrant component only accepts collection/host/port/score with no query-embedding or filter input, so search queries Qdrant's REST API directly and embeds the query via @meshify/embeddings.

nodes.label: Chat retrieval path (bypasses RocketRide)
nodes.rationale: RocketRide's qdrant node schema only exposes a fixed score-enum floor with no result-count cap; ~25 chunks landed in the prompt node and the LLM stopped grounding on them, answering generically even when the right file was retrieved. Retrieval moved to ChatContextRetriever, capped to top 8 chunks by score.

nodes.label: Why not PascalCase filenames
nodes.rationale: Case-only renames are hazardous across macOS (case-insensitive) vs Linux (case-sensitive) filesystems and Git; kebab-case is the dominant TS backend convention (NestJS et al.); the repo already follows it uniformly.
